description: GHOST RIMCLAP: the rim shot and the hand clap in one module, each played from its own sample with its own trigger and output

params.text: Sets the pitch of the clap, by the speed its sample is played at
Sets the pitch of the rim shot, by the speed its sample is played at
Sets the rim shot's output level

inputs.text: Fires the clap on a rise past 2V, and samples the accent jack at that instant
Fires the rim shot on a rise past 2V, and samples the accent jack at that instant
Raises the level and the accent character of a hit on either voice while it is high at the moment of its trigger, as Accent A, shared by the whole kit
Adds to the clap tune knob, the whole knob range over 10V
Adds to the clap level knob, the whole knob range over 10V
Adds to the rim tune knob, the whole knob range over 10V
Adds to the rim level knob, the whole knob range over 10V

notes: the total accent jack reads as accented while nothing is patched into it, so a voice on its own sounds at its accented level until you patch an accent gate
the accent amounts and master level come from a GHOST CTRL touching this module, or reaching it along a row of touching Ghost modules; with no controller the voice runs at its own settings
neither voice here reads Accent B; there is no local accent jack on this module

inputs.0:
high above 2V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.1:
high above 2V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.2:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads 10V, which reads as accented.
inputs.3:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 10V.
